basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) is recruiting candidates for 1 Postdoctoral Fellow vacancy on a contract basis in Rupnagar, Punjab. This purely temporary position is initially for one year and may be extended based on performance. The notified pay is Rs. 65,000 per month plus 9% HRA per month for applicants holding a Ph.D. degree or thesis submission certificate in Lasers/Quantum Optics completed within the past 5 years. how_to_apply: Prepare a completely filled application form as provided in the official notification.

Compile a detailed CV describing prior research and industrial experience, an overview of PhD work, a separate sheet listing publications and patents, copies of degree certificates, and a recommendation letter from your Supervisor or other mentors.
Merge all required documents into a single consolidated PDF file.
Send the email with the subject line “Application for Postdoctoral Position, your name” to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar)
Department under Dr. Vishwa Pal (Associate Professor)
Design and Development of Quantum Entanglement-Enhanced Imaging Systems
Initially for one year, extendable based on performance
Rs. 65,000/- per month + 9% HRA per month
Below 40 years on the last date of submission of the application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian Nationals fulfilling the following essential qualification: Essential Qualification: Ph.D. degree holders (or those having their Thesis submission certificate) in the area of Lasers/Quantum Optics. The applicant should have completed their PhD within the past 5 years. Upper Age Limit: Below 40 years on the last date of submission of the application.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Postdoctoral Fellow will receive a fellowship of Rs. 65,000/- per month plus 9% HRA per month. The position is purely temporary and is initially for a period of one year. The tenure may be extended for additional periods subject to satisfactory performance. Selected candidates must join immediately (within a few days) after receiving the offer letter as per Institute joining rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar Postdoctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare a completely filled application form as provided in the official notification. Compile a detailed CV describing prior research and industrial experience, an overview of PhD work, a separate sheet listing publications and patents, copies of degree certificates, and a recommendation letter from your Supervisor or other mentors. Merge all required documents into a single consolidated PDF file. Send the email with the subject line “Application for Postdoctoral Position, your name” to [email protected] . Ensure the application is received on or before 25 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The applications will be screened, and short-listed candidates will be called for an online interview.

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Application

rows.details: Download official advertisement and application form

faq.question: Q1. Is the Postdoctoral Fellow position permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and is initially for a period of one year, with the possibility of extension based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are any allowances paid on top of the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive a fellowship of Rs. 65,000/- per month plus 9% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the subject line required when emailing the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must write “Application for Postdoctoral Position, your name” in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit a filled application form, detailed CV, overview of PhD work, list of publications/patents on a separate sheet, copy of degree certificates, and a recommendation letter from a Supervisor or other mentors, all compiled into a single consolidated PDF file.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the position?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates will be called for an online interview.
